rarity._about: Placeholder balance data for #77 NEW ITEMS: each product's rarity comes from the product itself and it always arrives plain. Evidence: greedy@sensible reward picks and 'In row / Needed' from reports/p42_final_report.txt and reports/balance_sim/report.txt (fresh profile, 480/200 runs) for the 20 fresh-stock products; for the 30 capsule products (no pick data exists) the orphan check in reports/p42_final_report.txt plus rule strength read from data/cards. The build re-measures this with the simulator.

rarity.stock_rules: Fresh profile: the 6 staples + the Cold cases, Pantry and Household base items (RunStock.starting; the list is skipped since 14 items <= aisle_stock_budget 16). Full collection: every capsule unlocked, 44 aisle items > 16, so a run stocks the 6 staples + the 2 aisles the player lists (run_aisle_picks 2) + up to 3 new arrivals; full_collection_stock is every product any run can stock. Coupons (coupon_pool) are not products; Bundle is in no pool.

fallbacks.empty_tier: If the stock has no product of a rolled tier, that drop steps down a tier (then up if none), as REGISTER does. The odds card computes its numbers from the run's stock, so it still shows the true odds. Every fresh stock has 12 Common, 6 Rare, 2 Legendary. With the full collection, only the list Cold cases + Snacks (1 of 15 two-aisle lists) has no Legendary, unless a new arrival brings one.
fallbacks.generally_useful: The guarantee swaps one drop for a generally useful product of the same tier. Common always holds Banana and Bread, Rare always holds Milk and Eggs (staples), so it never needs to change a tier. Legendary holds one only when Household is stocked (Carrier bag). If all 3 drops roll Legendary and no generally useful Legendary is stocked, the guarantee is skipped for that visit (it may lift a tier, never lower one): 0.003% at Regular 0, 1.06% at Regular 3 (its drop 1 rolls only Rare or Legendary; e.g. Pantry + Bakery). Measured by flow/check_odds.js.
